summary: Frontend-only regression and code-review testing completed on the public URL. Root load, all 5 tabs, notification warning/fallback behavior, charts with 3 uniquely named categories, full create/persist/export flow, recurring and auto-save mount toasts/idempotency, dashboard KPIs, comparison, and auto-save history passed. FIX #2 remains incomplete for allowed duplicate category names, and Category/Goal edit dialogs fail to hydrate selected records.

ui_bugs.issue: Two categories with the same allowed name generate React's duplicate-key warning for 'pie-Duplicada'. The chart rendered 3 sectors in this run, but React warns that children may be duplicated or omitted during reconciliation.
Editing an existing category opens an Editar Categoría dialog with blank/default fields instead of the selected category values.
Editing an existing goal opens an Editar Meta dialog with blank/default fields instead of the selected goal values.

action_items: Propagate category id into Dashboard barData/pieData and use id-based Cell keys; category names are not unique, and the bar key remains index-dependent.
Synchronize CategoryDialog form state from initial whenever the dialog opens or the selected category changes.
Synchronize GoalDialog form state from initial whenever the dialog opens or the selected goal changes.
Retest duplicate-name chart reconciliation and both edit/save flows after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard Pie Cell uses key `pie-${entry.name}` even though category creation does not enforce unique names. Reproduced React duplicate-key warning with two categories named Duplicada. Bar Cell uses `bar-${entry.name}-${i}`, which avoids duplicates but is still not stable under reordering because it contains the array index and the name is truncated in barData.

CategoryDialog and GoalDialog derive form state with useState(initial...) only on component mount. Unlike FrequentDialog and RecurringDialog, they have no useEffect keyed by open/initial, so later edit selections never hydrate the form.
seed_data_creation: Used isolated finance_tracker_data_v1 fixtures and UI-created QA data for categories, current/previous-month incomes and expenses, a frequent expense, recurring income, goal, notifications, auto-save, duplicate category names, and edit-dialog diagnostics. No backend/shared data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FIX #1 passed: with Notification.permission mocked granted, enabling notifications in Ajustes and spending 850/1000 caused one SW showNotification attempt; forced SW rejection emitted console.warn containing TEST_SW_FAILURE and then attempted fallback Notification(). FIX #2 passed for three unique categories: 12 bar rectangles, 3 pie sectors, then 12/2 after switching month, with no key warnings or visual glitch. Duplicate category names reproduce warning 'Encountered two children with the same key, pie-Duplicada'. Full UI flow created two categories, FAB income/expense, Movimientos income/expense, frequent applied through FAB, recurring, goal, auto-save, USD currency, CSV/PDF downloads, and localStorage persistence. CSV/PDF filenames were finanzas_2026-08.csv/pdf. Seeded mount test rendered both recurring and auto-save success toasts; second reload created no duplicate data/toasts. USD is rendered as '$', not 'US$'.
rca_of_the_issue: Chart RCA: pieData discards category id and Cell identity is derived from non-unique category name; barData also discards id and includes array index in the key. Edit-dialog RCA: CategoryDialog and GoalDialog stay mounted while initial changes, but useState(initial...) runs only on first mount, leaving stale/blank state. Reproduction: seed c1/g1, click their edit buttons, and inspect category-name-input/goal-name-input; both are empty.
